findings.observation: Original-resolution inspection preserves Meian as the same mature band-5 adult man: broad oval face, close-set eyes, high arched brows with notch, small upturned nose, heavy lower lip, and calm closed-mouth age cues remain unmistakable rather than childlike.

The render retains the summon portrait's tall-language, healthy-slight, narrow, low-mass build through a slim shoulder line, fitted torso, and relatively long thin limbs without generic body widening or added muscular bulk.
Both upper arms, forearms, wrists, and empty hands remain slender and source-coherent; the hands are distinct and naturally articulated without fusion, duplication, or broad generic chibi inflation.
The gray-white-silver shaved close crop preserves the source's tight front and side silhouette and the clearly visible sculpted curved edge pattern.

The moss-ivory tailored cloth longcoat keeps its high collar, readable waist, three low-profile toggle closures, long split hem, pale plain underlayer, articulated trouser folds, and fitted shoes. No accessory or tattoo was invented; the thread gauge is appropriately omitted so both combat hands are empty.

The complete hair-top-to-chin unit occupies only about 28% of standing height, producing approximately 3.5 heads total. This is outside the frozen 32-36% / 2.75-3.1-head range and reads as a tall miniature despite the enlarged head.
Exactly one coherent full-body subject appears; the complete close crop, head, both empty hands, coat tails, both legs, both shoes, and grounding shadow remain inside clear safe margins.
A separated-foot stance, slightly bent limbs, compact clenched empty hands, and level alert gaze create a readable grounded weaponless ready-idle silhouette at combat-icon scale.

The presentation remains ordinary cloth and fitted shoes on a warm parchment wash, with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
